trap-superlative.notes: REPORT ONLY, not fixed (math). Disjoint supports in an orthogonal direct sum give ||sum_i x_i||^2 = sum_i ||x_i||^2 -- Pythagoras -- not ||sum_i x_i|| = sum_i ||x_i||, which is the equality case of the triangle inequality and requires the summands to be non-negatively aligned. The corpus already says this: the sibling lem:topological-mass-cat-eigenspace and its proof both state 'Orthogonal components add in **quadrature**, not linearly ... additivity would require alignment, not orthogonality'. (The DISPLAYED identity in this proof is about the trace, which is linear, and is fine; only this closing sentence about norms is wrong.) Third of three consumers of the corrected eigenspace lemma that still carry the linear form -- the others are topological-mass-conjecture.md and topological-mass-categorical-proof.md. Proposed: 'The disjointness of the supports makes the local traces mutually orthogonal, so their norms add in quadrature.'
